derivation: byte-identical copy; no re-drawing, tracing, optimisation or path edits
useCase: official VEEMAP brand mark for header, footer, favicon and social preview
notes: Mark is not monochrome: 32 fills at #000000 plus greens #1d5b25, #21672a, #329e41 and oranges #792d12, #7d2f13, #833114, #d24e1f.

Fills are hard-coded, so currentColor and CSS recolouring cannot produce a dark-theme treatment. On the dark ground (--ink #000) the black portions of the mark disappear. A dark-theme treatment therefore needs separate owner approval.
Logo orange #d24e1f is close to but not identical with the site signal colour --signal #fa4c14, and the greens sit outside the DESIGN.md palette entirely.
Contains 5 clipPath ids with fixed values; if this file is ever inlined more than once per document the ids must be namespaced to avoid collisions.
Not yet wired into the site. The header currently renders the CSS-drawn SpinningBrandMark component, not this asset.
